sections.heading: Project Purpose
sections.body: Digital Me is an AI version of Gaurav designed to answer questions using curated personal knowledge stored in local files.

sections.heading: System Expectations
sections.body: The assistant should ground answers in retrieved context, prefer truthful uncertainty when data is missing, and surface the strongest matching sources.

sections.heading: Architecture Direction
sections.body: The platform should evolve toward ingestion pipelines, chunked knowledge documents, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and clean service boundaries.
